Items bought on Cartwheel can be returned within 30 days of delivery. The window counts from the delivery date, not the purchase date. Items must be in the condition described by the store's listing. Individual stores may override this window; see the store overrides polic

results.snippet:
# Cartwheel order cancellation policy

An order can be cancelled at no cost any time before the store ships it. Once an order has shipped it can no longer be cancelled; the buyer should instead wait for delivery and request a return under the Cartwheel return policy.
results.title: Cartwheel order cancellation policy

results.snippet:
# Cartwheel shipping policy

Stores ship orders within 3 days of purchase. Standard delivery takes up to 7 days in transit after shipment. Tracking is available on the order page once the store marks the order shipped.

content.body:
# Cartwheel return policy

Items bought on Cartwheel can be returned within 30 days of delivery. The window counts from the delivery date, not the purchase date. Items must be in the condition described by the store's listing. Individual stores may override this window; see the store overrides policy and the store's own policy page.
content.title: Cartwheel return policy

content.body:
# Cartwheel refund policy

Approved refunds go back to the original payment method and arrive in 5 to 10 business days. Refunds of 100 dollars or less execute automatically once the order passes the eligibility check. Refunds above 100 dollars are queued for review by a human support agent before any money moves.

# Cartwheel dispute policy

Buyers can dispute a charge for up to 60 days after delivery. Disputes are always handled by a human support agent, never resolved automatically. Opening a dispute pauses any pending refund on the same order.
content.title: Cartwheel dispute policy

arguments.context: User id 9005, store id 5, role merchant. Question: disputed order payout on hold, what happens to funds. Policies checked: cw-payouts (weekly Friday payouts) and cw-disputes (human-handled, pauses refunds). Needs human review for specific hold/funds status.
arguments.summary: Merchant (store 5) asks about disputed order with payout on hold - what happens to funds

trace.text:
Thanks for checking — great question.

Here's what I can share from our policies:

* Per **cw-payouts**, merchant payouts run weekly on Fridays and take 2 business days to process after the run.
* Per **cw-disputes**, disputes are always handled by a human support agent, never resolved automatically, and opening a dispute pauses any pending refund on the same order.

What exactly happens to funds while a payout is on hold for a disputed order depends on the specific case, so I'm not able to confirm that here.

I've opened a ticket for a human specialist to review your store's hold — **ticket 185**. A human will follow up within 24 hours.
